```diff
# src/decision_packet.py
+def lead_permission_allow_hint(workspace, charter=None):
+    """Return allow_hint string for system_install with install_roots."""
+    if not charter or charter.get("task_kind") != "system_install \
+       or not charter.get("install_roots"):
+        return "Allowed workspace: {}.".format(workspace or "(job workdir)")
+
+    roots = [str(r).strip() for r in charter["install_roots"] if r]
+    roots_s = ", ".join(roots)
 +    return (
+        f"Allowed workspace: {workspace or '(job workdir)'}. "
+        f"Authorized install_roots: {roots_s}. "
+        "install_execute under those roots (rm/delete root, git clone, "
+        "npm install, start server) is in-char ter: prefer once. "
+        "Do not demand_safe_path for in-root actions. "
+        "Still reject/demand_safe_path for secret-adjacent paths, sudo, "
+        "firewall, etc."
+    )
+
+def permission_authorized_scope(charter, workspace=""):
+ """Extend authorized_scope with install_roots list + once-guidance."""
+  scope = list(charter.get("must") or [])
+  if not scope and workspace:
+      scope = [f"stay inside workspace {workspace}"]
+  if charter.get("task_kind") == "system_install" and \
+     charter.get("install_roots"):
+      scope = list(scope)
+      scope.append(f"install_roots: {charter['install_roots']}")
+      scope.append("install_execute under install_roots: once, not demand_safe_path")
+  return scope
```
